text: Retirement policy analysis reveals critical path divergence. Dataflow implementation (line 653) enforces comprehensive pin lifetime: rejects retirement if object pinned, held by session root, or used by active sandboxes. Legacy path (line 93) only sets retiring flag without pin checks - race condition risk where pinned objects can be deallocated. Both paths lack audit metadata beyond error messages. Admission policies similarly split: object admission validates capacity (line 74), sandbox admission validates task state (line 583), but neither logs policy decisions. Recommendation: Add pin validation to legacy retire() and implement audit logging for both paths to ensure consistent lifetime guarantees across implementations.
